title: XXXII: Target Formation
description: Framed large-scale collage dense with layered paper elements including warplane silhouettes in side and top-down views, concentric target rings, a black chess king, an American football, vinyl records, and red rectangular blocks. Numerals 'XXXII' and 'DMS' appear at lower center amid scattered roundels and bullseye motifs.
composition: layered collage elements within framed border
